Why did Ptolemy have the planets orbiting Earth on ‘circles upon circles’ in his model of the universe?
Option A: To explain why more distant planets take longer to make a circuit through the constellations of the zodiac.
Option B: To explain the fact that planets sometimes appear to move westward rather than eastward relative to the stars in our sky.
Option C: To explain why the Greeks were unable to detect stellar paralax.
Option D: To properly account for the varying distances of the planets from Earth.
